title: 小蝌蚪怎么变成青蛙
subtitle: 先长后腿，再长前腿，尾巴自己没了
character: wearing a grass green t-shirt, khaki shorts and blue rubber boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible hatching strokes and grainy layered colour, pond green, warm yellow and soft brown

pages.zh:
春天，池塘边，
水里有一群黑点。
它们摆着尾巴游，
爸爸说那不是鱼，
是小蝌蚪。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy crouching at the edge of a pond, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, looking down into the water with delight.

pages.zh:
它们从卵里孵出来。
一团透明的果冻，
里面点着黑芝麻。
每一粒黑芝麻，
将来都是一只青蛙。
pages.scene: One clear round mass of transparent jelly floating in still water on a cream background, many small dark round dots set inside the jelly, no adult animal and no face anywhere in the picture. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
刚出来的蝌蚪
没有腿，也没有肺。
它的脖子两边
长着一丛鳃，
像鱼一样在水里呼吸。

过了几个星期，
它的屁股后面
先鼓出两个小包。
小包慢慢伸长，
变成两条后腿。

后腿长好了，
前腿才开始长。
前腿先藏在皮里，
有一天早上，
忽然从两边顶出来。

这时候尾巴
开始一天天变短。
它不是断掉的，
也不是被谁咬掉的。
是身体把它吃回去了。
pages.scene: One tadpole with four legs and only a very short stub of tail left on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鳃也在慢慢不见。
身体里长出了肺。
从今往后，
它得浮到水面上，
用鼻孔吸一口空气。

肚子里也在变。
蝌蚪吃水草，
肠子盘得又细又长。
青蛙要吃虫子，
肠子就变短变粗。

从吃素改成吃肉，
嘴也跟着变宽了。
还多了一条长舌头，
卷住一只虫子
只要一眨眼。
pages.scene: One frog on a cream background shooting out its long tongue to catch a small flying insect. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
尾巴剩最后一点点，
它就爬上了荷叶。
四条腿一蹬，
扑通一声跳进水里，
这回是青蛙了。
pages.scene: One frog sitting on a flat lily pad on a cream background, seen from the side, crouched and about to jump. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
卵、蝌蚪、
长腿蝌蚪、青蛙，
四个模样，
是同一只小东西。
它把自己改了一遍。

我蹲在池塘边看，
找那只尾巴最短的。
尾巴不是丢了，
是变成了它自己
身上的一部分。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy at the pond holding a clear jar with one tadpole in it, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, thoughtful.
